newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee seen at 61/dlr end-97 - bank.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee seen at 61/dlr end-97 - bank.

text.p: The Sri Lankan dollar is likely to slip by around four percent to 61 to the dollar by the end of the year, the state-owned Bank of Ceylon said.

The bank said in a report by its economic research division, received by Reuters on Wednesday, that the rupee had depreciated against the dollar by 2.84 percent during the first five months of the year.
It noted other forecasts expected the rupee to depreciate to as low as 62 to the dollar by year end.
"Economic Research Division, Bank of Ceylon projects...a rate of 61 per dollar," the report said.
A Reuters poll of eight foreign exchange dealers at leading local and foreign commercial banks last month predicted the rupee would end 1997 around 60.85 to the U.S. currency.
The rupee was trading at 58.7 to the dollar on Wednesday.
